name: Fresh passport (adult, first passport)
description: Apply for your first passport if you have never held one: an adult citizen by birth submits proof of present address and proof of date of birth.
description_hi: यदि आपके पास कभी पासपोर्ट नहीं रहा है, तो पहले पासपोर्ट के लिए आवेदन करें: जन्म से नागरिक वयस्क वर्तमान पते का प्रमाण और जन्म तिथि का प्रमाण जमा करते हैं।
verification_notes: Modelled for Table 2 (I) A.1 only (adult, citizen of India by birth, normal application). Non-ECR proof (Document No. 3) applies only to applicants eligible for Non-ECR and is not modelled; police verification is decided by the Passport Office. Minors, Tatkaal and other categories are not modelled. Some listed date-of-birth proofs (insurance policy bond, service record, EPIC with full date of birth, orphanage declaration) are not modelled. The jurisdictional Passport Office may ask for additional documents.

requirements.name: Proof of present address (any one)
requirements.notes: Proof of the present address only is needed, irrespective of how long you have lived there. Some other documents with the same present address may also be accepted.

options.notes: Only public limited companies, on letterhead with seal.
Only if your present address matches the address in your spouse's passport.
Subject to successful validation with the Aadhaar database.
Photo passbook of a running account in a scheduled public/private sector Indian bank or RRB only.

requirements.name: Proof of date of birth (any one)

options.notes: Should contain the child's name, parents' names, date and place of birth, sex, registration number and date.
Transfer/school leaving/matriculation certificate with the date of birth.
Only if it shows the complete date of birth.
Only if it shows the complete date of birth.
